title: Avalon-M1: Reinforcement Learning from Collective Rewards
abstract: arXiv:2611.32539v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We introduce reinforcement learning from collective rewards (RLCR), a recipe for jointly training language models to act as agent organisations under latency constraints. A CEO and up to eight specialists share one policy, co-ordinate through a message board and workspace, and are trained with a common outcome-derived advantage. The deadline makes parallel work valuable when it increases the return earned before the cap. We train Avalon-M1-Mini (120B) across 147 environments. For the trained model, eight-hire organisational execution raises IMO-ProofBench-Advanced scores from 23.8% to 39.0% relative to single-agent execution. Across 12 benchmarks, organisations achieve similar average scores at approximately one-third the derived latency of token-matched single-agent execution and just over half that of eight independent attempts followed by selection. translated_title: Avalon-M1：基于集体奖励的强化学习
translated_abstract: 我们提出了基于集体奖励的强化学习，这是一种在延迟约束下将语言模型联合训练为智能体组织的方法。一个CEO和最多八名专家共享同一个策略，通过消息板和工作空间进行协调，并使用由共同结果派生的优势进行训练。截止期限使得并行工作在能够增加时间上限前所获收益时变得有价值。我们在147个环境中训练了Avalon-M1-Mini（120B）。对于训练后的模型，八人雇佣组织执行相对于单智能体执行，将IMO-ProofBench-Advanced分数从23.8%提升至39.0%。在12个基准测试中，组织以约等于token匹配的单智能体执行三分之一、以及八次独立尝试后选择的一半多的延迟，取得了相似的平均分数。训练后的模型还优于基于相同基础模型后训练的Nemotron 3 Super。
tldr: Avalon-M1提出基于集体奖励的强化学习（RLCR），联合训练CEO与最多八名专家共享同一策略的智能体组织，在延迟约束下将IMO-ProofBench-Advanced分数从23.8%提升至39.0%，并以约单智能体三分之一的延迟在12个基准上取得相当的平均性能。
en_tdlr: Avalon-M1 introduces Reinforcement Learning from Collective Rewards (RLCR) to jointly train a shared-policy agent organisation (a CEO plus up to eight specialists), raising IMO-ProofBench-Advanced scores from 23.8% to 39.0% while matching single-agent performance across 12 benchmarks at roughly one-third the latency.
